controls: All eight elements of H=M24 intersect ker(loc_S), with dim_F2(H)=3.
missing_panel: The eight elements of R+H, where R=P4+P12+P18+P23+P27 is used only after the control benchmark has passed.
representative_normalisation: For a nonzero displayed control word, form its exact group sum only in the sealed preparer, then use the normalized Kummer representative 4*x(Q)-theta. This is square-equivalent to the word product. The isolated solver receives only the resulting quadrics, never Q, alpha, a word, a coset label, or a cover witness.

solver.engine: Magma GenusOneModel Reduce followed by PointsQI

advance_rules: The eight H controls are a solver benchmark. At least one nonzero H class must yield an exact returned rational cover point before R+H jobs are prepared.
Only a PASS control artifact authorizes the R+H panel.
Only PASS control and missing-panel artifacts reopen the generic-only principal-relation constructor gate. The missing words remain forbidden inputs to that constructor.
boundaries: A control representative is intentionally retrospective and known soluble; it is not a new direction.
No rational cover witness is written to, or read by, a solver job. Cover points are mapped and checked only after the isolated solver exits.
A bounded miss remains a bounded solver outcome, not an obstruction or a Sha conclusion.
